paperTitle: CancerSB: A Serious Adventure Game for Bone Cancer Education and Awareness with ChatGPT 4o-driven Preliminary Validation
centralContribution: This study introduces CancerSB, a serious adventure game designed to raise awareness and provide education about bone cancer through an engaging point-and-click experience. The paper also presents a novel preliminary validation methodology utilizing ChatGPT 4o to generate simulated user feedback from diverse "mega-personas," guiding early design choices before real user testing.

content.description: Figure 3 visually demonstrates the core educational mechanism of CancerSB, where real-world architectural landmarks within the game's culturally themed regions are conceptually mapped onto a human skeleton. This mapping helps players understand and visualize specific bone regions prone to different types of cancer, making complex medical information intuitive and interactive.

content.description: CancerSB is a serious adventure game for bone cancer education, filling a critical gap in engaging resources for adolescents and young adults. It uses culturally themed regions and boss battles to teach about cancer types. A novel preliminary validation method employs ChatGPT 4o and 'mega-personas' to gather simulated feedback, which was largely positive, guiding early design. The main limitation is the reliance on simulated feedback.
